title: Old Drama+mandolin
lyrics:
(Old drama, old script)
(Pick it up and tell)
(Watched many times)
(A story of a person, thick lust..oh)

A big drama, many episodes
Meandering, twisting, reflection, benefits
Grab power, set the drawing, as you please
The mind is crooked, never stop, reduce, let go

A big drama, play according to the script
Do it smoothly, as the master wishes
An old drama, play according to the flag
Set the script, as you want it to be

The outside is bright, but the inside is dark
It seems that it is better than anything
But the rotten smell, wafts far away
Trying to hide it, but can't hide it

A big drama, see until it's disgusting
The writer is full of lust, desire, pride
Has a heart that is completely dark
When the end of life, sin will follow you..
********************
